The null-guard lint refuses an unguarded ordering over `record.created_at` / `record.updated_at` in every `beforeInsert` hook condition. Only a hook below priority 10 actually reads them null, so hooks at or above 10 are falsely refused. Authoring friction from a false refusal, so p3.
